name: Ethel Cain
description:
'''Hayden Silas Anhedönia''' ({{IPAc-en|ˌ|æ|n|h|ɪ|ˈ|d|oʊ|n|i|ə}}; born March 24, 1998), known professionally as '''Ethel Cain''', is an American singer-songwriter, record producer, and model. She became known for her [[Ambient music|ambient]] and [[Southern Gothic]]-style music and lyrics. She began releasing recordings under various aliases,{{Efn|While Ethel Cain is her main project, Anhedönia has had other projects under different monikers, including '''White Silas'''}} before releasing multiple [[extended play]]s including ''[[Inbred (EP)|Inbred]]'' (2021) which garnered various singles including "[[Crush (Ethel Cain song)|Crush]]".

Cain released her debut studio album, ''[[Preacher's Daughter]]'' (2022), to acclaim from critics and garnered a [[cult following]]. After a vinyl release in 2025, the album debuted at number ten on the US [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]] chart, making Cain the first openly [[transgender]] artist to reach the top ten. She released the studio recording ''[[Perverts (album)|Perverts]]'' (2025), which saw her experimenting with [[drone music]]. Later that year, she released her second studio album, ''[[Willoughby Tucker, I'll Always Love You]]'' (2025), which served as a lyrical [[prequel]] to her debut album.
